title: Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. translated_title: 面向社会部署的AI智能体的行为保障
translated_abstract: AI智能体正越来越多地被部署在具有社会重要性的场景中，然而现有评估方法对于智能体在多样化交互中能否与其预期特性保持行为一致，所能提供的保障十分有限。我们提出了一个用于衡量社会部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架。该框架沿五个可测量的维度对智能体行为进行操作化，并使用一套覆盖六种社会显著性交互场景的标准化评估组合，以评估行为的分化、一致性与漂移。受控的人设（persona）配置被用作实验锚点，从而能够系统性地检验预期的行为差异是否能跨情境持续存在，而非仅表现为风格上的变化。初步分析表明，不同配置之间存在可测量的行为分化，并显示行为特征与交互结果之间存在关联。通过将焦点从……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个衡量社会部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架，通过五个可测量行为维度和覆盖六种社会交互场景的标准化评估组合，借助受控人设配置系统检验智能体的行为差异与一致性是否能跨情境稳定保持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents, operationalizing behavior along five measurable axes with a standardized battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings, using controlled persona configurations as experimental anchors to systematically test whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts.
